gen.title: Review of DNA copying and lab uses

cards.stem: What recognition was given to the creator of this DNA copying method
cards.quote: its creator, Kary B. Mullis, was awarded the Nobel Prize for Chemistry in 1993.
cards.hint: Recall the major chemistry honor mentioned

cards.stem: Which laboratory technique is listed as a use for amplified DNA
cards.quote: including DNA fingerprinting, detection of bacteria or viruses (particularly AIDS), and diagnosis of genetic disorders.
cards.hint: Think about identification methods for samples

cards.stem: Which enzyme builds new strands using original strands as templates
cards.quote: Next, an enzyme called "Taq polymerase" synthesizes - builds - two new strands of DNA, using the original strands as templates.
cards.hint: Look for the named enzyme in the process

cards.stem: How is the repetition of the denaturing and synthesizing cycle described
options: more than one billion exact copies
cards.quote: The cycle of denaturing and synthesizing new DNA is repeated as many as 30 or 40 times
cards.hint: Check how many cycles are described
